insight_summary: Leader on CVR: #4 offer at CVR 4.99% (95% CI 3.25%–7.58%, n=401 clicks, directional). Its interval overlaps the runner-up (#2 demo), so it is not a confirmed winner yet. Lowest: #3 storytelling at CVR 1.30% (95% CI 0.36%–4.61%, n=154 clicks, insufficient data). The next batch keeps most variants close to what is working and reserves one for exploration.
limitations: These metrics are SIMULATED sample data for the demo. They are not real campaign results.
Imported CSV data is only as accurate as the export it came from.
Some concepts have too little data to judge; their ranks can change a lot with more delivery.
Several results are early signals; wait for more data before cutting budget.
This is observational data: a higher rate is correlation, not proof that the creative caused it (audience, timing and delivery also differ).
Ranked by conversion rate (conversions ÷ clicks), the metric that matches a sales/leads objective.
